excludedSources.reason: Container composing PendingInvitationsMenuSurface with workspace-scoped invitation actions.
Retained re-export barrel so stories/tests/fixtures keep one import path; individual workspace surfaces are registered separately.

notApplicable.reason: Invitations render resolved data passed by its parent; query loading presentation is owned by the workspace shell.
Invitations render resolved data passed by its parent; query error presentation is owned by the workspace shell.
Invitations render a bounded popover list; high-density input is exercised by the EdgeData story.
No product-authoritative read-only contract exists for pending invitations at this baseline.
No product-authoritative permission-limited capability contract exists for pending invitations at this baseline.
Invitations render bounded inviter/workspace name strings; long-text and Unicode edge input is exercised by the directory EdgeData story.

Sidebar entries are navigation; Workspaces defines no read-only member state that changes them. Department creation is gated by canCreateRoot and proven by the departments case; pins and recents moved to Home.
The topbar holds navigation, the palette trigger and the theme toggle; none of them changes workspace data, so a read-only member sees the same topbar.
The palette lists only resources the host already loaded through authorized lists and actions the member can run; it has no read-only variant.
The rail lists the member's own workspace memberships and account-level entries; guest memberships are labelled, and no read-only member state changes what the rail offers.
A successful create closes the dialog and navigates to the new Board or Doc; the confirmation toast is owned by the host.
One short name field bounded by maxLength; long and Unicode names are exercised by the Home and Library EdgeData stories.
Members who cannot create never see the dialog: the create actions are not offered (WX-HOME-002).
Without inline completion the list stays a list of links; covered by the read-only interaction case rather than a separate visual state.
My work lists only the member's own assigned Items, authorized by the producer (WX-BE-005); there is no partial-permission rendering.

Reading is the only mode: every write (Đã xử lý, mark all read) is a host callback and is drawn inert without one, covered by the handled-inert and mark-all interaction cases rather than a separate visual state.
The Inbox lists the member's own notifications, authorized by the producer; there is no partial-permission rendering.
Member lists are bounded by workspace seats; the EdgeData story renders 30 members with long Unicode names.

A Space page lists the visible child Spaces, Boards and Docs of one Space; dense lists are the Boards & Docs directory (workspace.library HighDensity) and the sidebar tree (workspace.space-tree HighDensity).
A successful create closes the dialog and navigates to the new Space; the confirmation toast is owned by the host.
Members who cannot create a Space there are never offered the dialog (GOV-028).
A successful move closes the dialog; the tree and the toast are owned by the host.
Members who cannot move the Space, Board or Doc are never offered the dialog; unavailable destinations are shown disabled with the reason (Default).
Teams are managed by workspace admins and owners only; every other viewer gets the whole list read-only (ReadOnly), never a partial set of actions.
A successful create closes the dialog and navigates to the new Team; the confirmation toast is owned by the host.
Viewers who cannot manage Teams are never offered the dialog (GOV-026).
